protected_holdout.rule: Do not read or derive operator outcome metrics from this interval until a transferable operator-derived strategy rule is frozen.

operator_book_rules.owner_identity: mint recipient must match an indexed Ramses position owner for the pool; burns use frozen burn-ownership resolution
operator_book_rules.closed_book: final DLMMPosition liquidity equals zero, last modification is before discovery cutoff, and no attributed owner mint/burn occurs after cutoff
operator_book_rules.pnl: resolved burn USD minus all owner-attributed mint USD; unresolved burns can only make this a conservative lower bound
operator_book_rules.capital_hour_metric: cash-capital proxy integrating max(0, prior capital + mint USD - burn USD) through time; screening metric only, not exact economic capital
operator_book_rules.multi_action: more than one mint or more than one burn in the owner/pool book

reverse_engineering_dimensions: position placement relative to last active bin
historical per-bin fee attribution versus inventory PnL

targeted_fill_policy.allowed: Only finalists after offline ranking; exact receipts/state, gas, incentives/rewards, and historical terminal unwind where missing.

promotion_boundary: This study may nominate transferable strategy hypotheses. It may not promote a Ramses strategy until a rule is frozen without holdout outcomes and then passes the protected chronological holdout.
